Subject: Partner paper & marketplace billing: initial alignment

Hi Maya / Nimbus team,

Thanks for the call earlier — appreciated the clarity on how CloudMarx is running billing for your marketplace listings. Per our discussion, attached are two items for your review: an MSA redline that includes a marketplace addendum placeholder and a draft Order Form that calls out reseller pass-through pricing.

Key asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether Nimbus requires invoice-level passthrough (Marketplace invoices customer directly) or whether you prefer Redwood to invoice the customer and remit to the partner?
- Any specific tax treatment or commission split that must appear on the Order Form?
- If CloudMarx requires Partner Paper language (their standard partner flow), will Nimbus accept an explicit pass-through clause that limits Redwood liability for partner-initiated billing differences?

I’ve CC'd Laura from Legal and Karthik on Partnerships so they can suggest language and constraints. If you can reply with the preference (Marketplace direct billing vs Redwood billing + remit) and a sample partner-paper clause you need, we’ll convert that into a redline and send a DocuSign-ready Order Form.

Attachments: MSA_Redline_Redwood_v2.docx (redline, 45KB), OrderForm_Nimbus_20260914.pdf (draft Order Form, 14KB)

Next steps: If we can get confirmation today, we’ll target a signed Order Form by end of week and route a quick credit note flow if any commission adjustments are required post-signature.

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Shah <procurement@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partner@cloudmarx.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner paper & marketplace billing: initial alignment

Thanks Priya — quick answers from procurement:

- Nimbus prefers marketplace direct billing where possible: CloudMarx issues the invoice to our account and passes through pricing/discounts. That is their default for listed solutions.
- Commission split and tax treatment vary by partner; for this opportunity we expect a standard 15% reseller commission (gross). Nimbus needs the order form to show list price and a partner discount line so our finance team can reconcile margins.
- Regarding partner paper: CloudMarx asked us to request that Redwood accept a limited passthrough clause that acknowledges partner-led billing and limits Redwood’s liability to accuracy of usage data and timely settlement. Nimbus cannot accept Redwood being the sole invoicer for Marketplace listings unless CloudMarx approves it.

We will attach CloudMarx’s partner-paper excerpt shortly (looping them on this thread). Can you produce an Order Form with both options noted (1) Marketplace direct billing and (2) Redwood invoices + remit to partner, with the partner-paper clause as an exhibit for legal review?

On timelines: our procurement deadline for this quarter is 9/24, so we need a signed Order Form before then.

Best,
Maya Shah
Senior Procurement Manager, NimbusCloud

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>

Laura — forwarding Nimbus’ response. They want marketplace direct billing by default and have asked for partner-paper passthrough language that limits Redwood liability to usage accuracy and settlement timeliness.

Can Legal weigh in on:
- Whether we can accept a partner-paper passthrough clause that disclaims Redwood liability for partner invoicing errors but still leaves Redwood on the hook for our service commitments (SLA/uptime).
- Recommended Order Form language to show list price, partner discount line, and a fallback: if CloudMarx cannot pass-through taxes correctly, Redwood will invoice and offset payments to partner afterwards.

Attachments: CloudMarx_PartnerPaper_excerpt.pdf (sent by CloudMarx to Nimbus, 8KB)

If possible, please provide a short paragraph we can include in the Order Form (and a redline for the MSA) so I can send to Nimbus and the partner within the afternoon.

Thanks — Priya

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Partner paper & marketplace billing: initial alignment

Priya / Karthik — see proposed approach and suggested contract language below. High-level: we can accept a partner-paper passthrough but we must protect Redwood on three points: 1) liability cap remains tied to fees paid to Redwood (not partner), 2) Redwood must retain right to invoice the end-customer if partner billing fails, and 3) explicit notice + cure periods for any partner billing disputes.

Suggested Order Form exhibit (short paragraph to include):
"Partner Billing; Marketplace Listings: Where partner marketplace terms require the partner or marketplace to invoice the Customer directly ("Partner Billing"), Redwood will cooperate with Partner to provide usage and invoicing data. Redwood's liability with respect to Partner Billing is limited to (a) the accuracy of usage reports Redwood provides to Partner and (b) Redwood's failure to deliver Services per the Agreement. Notwithstanding Partner Billing, Redwood may, in the event Partner fails to bill or remit amounts due to Redwood within thirty (30) days of payment becoming due, invoice the Customer directly and offset any amounts owed to Partner."

Redlines to MSA: I attached an MSA redline with two edits — (1) add the Partner Billing exhibit above, (2) narrow the indemnity carveout so Redwood is not responsible for partner pricing claims that arise solely from partner-controlled billing or marketplace display.

If Nimbus insists on 15% commission being visible on the Order Form, that’s acceptable but we should include a note: "Partner commission shown for reconciliation only; Redwood's fees are as listed in Section X." That keeps our fee schedule uncoupled from partner margin disputes.

I am attaching: MSA_Redline_Redwood_v2.docx (tracked changes) and a draft Order Form snippet you can paste into the PDF.

Attachments: MSA_Redline_Redwood_v2.docx (legal redline, 46KB), OrderForm_snippet_for_Nimbus.txt (2KB)

Let me know if you want me on the call with Nimbus later today — happy to join a 20-minute legal sync.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Updated Order Form + DocuSign (two-path billing option)

Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is an updated Order Form that includes: (a) two selectable billing paths (Marketplace direct billing or Redwood invoices + remit), (b) an exhibit with the partner billing paragraph from our Legal team, and (c) a partner commission reconciliation line for Nimbus' finance team.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123

Summary of key points in this Order Form:
- If Marketplace direct billing is selected, Redwood's liability is limited as described in the Partner Billing exhibit; Redwood will supply usage reports and reconcile on a monthly cadence.
- If Redwood invoices and remits, Redwood will invoice the Customer and schedule remittance to the Partner within 45 days after payment receipt (subject to verification).
- We included the 15% commission line as requested for reconciliation; Redwood's fees are stated independently in Section 2.1.

Next steps: Please confirm which billing path Nimbus prefers and sign the Order Form via the DocuSign link above. If CloudMarx needs additional edits to the exhibit language, ask them to mark up the DocuSign or send comments and we’ll iterate.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week.

Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
